welcomeMessageVideo.title: Welcome to the Statistics from Space Platform -  Mozambique Crop Statistics
welcomeMessageVideo.description: The Statistics from Space project aims to develop and realize a robust system for agricultural production statistics in Mozambique. The foreseen eventual user is the MAAP, being the Ministério da Agricultura, Ambiente e Pescas (Ministry of Agriculture and Environment and Fisheries).. At present, our second-year pilot involves three provinces: Gaza, Manica and Zambezia. In 2025, we conducted feldwork in the three provinces. Environmental conditions were such that not all sampling areas could be visited. The monitor page informs about completion levels. The project is a collaboration between IFPRI (Washington, DC), University of Twente ITC (The Netherlands), Universidade Eduardo Mondlane (Maputo, Mozambique) and Seoul National University (South Korea). Funding comes from South Korea's Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (MAFRA).
